title: potentilla hirta var. laciniosa
intro: Potentilla hirta var. laciniosa, commonly known as the Himalayan or Tibetan cinquefoil, is a plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla hirta var. laciniosa include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
